conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Brooks, badge ID 417256. Who am I speaking with today?
Uh, hi, my name is Pradeep Sharma. I got a message to contact this number about my taxes?
Yes, Mr. Sharma, thank you for calling. I have your file here. There appears to be a discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the last two years.
Discrepancy? I thought my employer did everything correctly. What is wrong with my taxes?
Our investigation shows an unpaid tax balance of $3,972.36, and suspicious activity linked to your Social Security Number. This is now a federal case.
Wait, what do you mean suspicious activity? I never did anything wrong!
Mr. Sharma, failure to resolve this matter immediately will result in issuance of an arrest warrant for tax evasion and possible asset seizure. Do you understand the seriousness of your situation?
Arrest warrant? No, no, I did not know. Please, I am very worried. What should I do?
Right now, your file is on hold, but if we do not receive payment in full today, law enforcement will be dispatched to your address within the next two hours.
No, please! I am here on a work visa, I cannot have any problems with the law. How can I fix this?

Since you have called back promptly, the IRS can allow you to settle your outstanding tax debt before the warrant is activated. However, you must follow my instructions precisely and not disconnect this call.
Yes, yes, I will do whatever you say. I just do not want to be arrested.

We are temporarily authorized to accept payment via prepaid gift cards due to the urgency and because your bank account is flagged. You need to purchase $3,972 worth of Target or Best Buy gift cards right away.
Gift cards? I thought IRS only takes bank transfer or check. This is confusing.
This is a special government protocol for cases under fraud investigation. If you delay or refuse, the IRS will proceed with legal action. I strongly recommend you comply.
Okay, okay. Where do I buy these gift cards? Can you explain?
Go to the nearest Target or Best Buy and purchase gift cards in increments of $500. As soon as you buy each card, stay on the phone and read me the numbers from the back. Do you understand?
Yes, I think so. But I do not have that much money in my account.
The minimum you must pay today to stop the arrest is $2,000. Any less, and the warrant will not be canceled. How much can you afford immediately?
Maybe $2,000, if I use my credit card.
That will suffice for now. Once the payment is processed, we can arrange monthly installments for the remainder. Start heading to the store and notify me when you arrive.
Alright, I am going to the store now. Please do not send police to my house.
As long as you cooperate, your file is on hold. Remember, do not speak to anyone about this case as it is under federal investigation. Are you at the store yet?
Almost, I am just parking now.
Good. Once inside, buy four gift cards of $500 each. Do not mention you are paying taxes, just say they are for personal use if asked.
Okay, I will do that. After I buy, I call you back?
No, stay on the line. After you have the cards, read me each card number and security code from the back so I can verify the payment. Understood?
Yes, I understand. Please, I do not want any trouble.
You are doing the right thing. If you follow my instructions, you will not face any further penalties.
